ns2:section.sectionText: On-campus section. Optional overnight field trip to the Katherine Dunham Centers for Arts and Humanities in East St. Louis, IL -- dates TBA. Transportation to and lodging accommodations for the East St. Louis field trip will be paid by the East St. Louis Action Research Project (ESLARP). Students who can not participate in the field trip will work on other projects. [Elective for the Graduate Certificate in Special Collections (see http://www.lis.uiuc.edu/programs/mbms/certificate.html).]
